sn1.50:1.1: This discourse, with more background, is also at [sn2.24](). | Aviha is one of the realms in which non-returners are born. The speaker is announcing that these seven have become perfected ones in that realm.
sn1.50:3.1: An Ājīvaka ascetic named Upaka met the Buddha shortly after his awakening, but was unconvinced ([mn26:25.1]()); the commentary says that this was he. Another Upaka, a layman, encounters the Buddha at [an4.188](). | Palagaṇḍa means “mason”, but no-one of that name is known.
